QuestInfo.0: Go wild this summer and earn yourself some awesome prizes!
QuestInfo.1: Look over the summer goal checklist.
QuestInfo.2: You heard about all the exciting things going on!

0.0: Have you ever tried stacking crowns on your head? I know it sounds like a pain in the neck... hehe... haha... That was a good one... ANYWAY, it's super fun.

no.0: Don't let a bad pun get in the way of a good time.

yes.0: You've seen everybody putting crowns on their heads around town, right? That's because they're trying to get some awesome achievements during the event.
yes.1: Once you've reached peak stacking awesomeness, you can click on the #bgift box icon next to the goal's name#k and get your gift. I can't wait to see how cool you look!
